constraints: path and comments must be the same kind (both Text, or both Text array); the two syntaxes cannot be mixed.

overloadMerges.note: comments is filled in by the command (parameter table marks it with the '←' return arrow), so its direction should be 'out', not the syntax-position default of 'in'.

params.name: path
params.description: Text or Text array containing one or more method path(s)

params.name: comments
params.description: Documentation of designated method(s) (markdown in project databases, styled text in binary databases)
If passed, applies to the host database's methods when called from a component (otherwise ignored).
